description: This file defines the `ParamRuleCollection` class responsible for managing a collection of parameter validation rules, including functionalities for adding, removing, and configuring validation rules and exclusions within the OrangeHRM API v2 context.

classes.name: ParamRuleCollection
classes.description: Class for collecting and managing validation rules for API request parameters, with support for strict mode and parameter key exclusions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the collection with optional ParamRule objects.

methods.name: getParamValidations
methods.description: Retrieves all ParamRule validations as an array.

methods.name: setParamValidations
methods.description: Sets multiple ParamRule validations at once, replacing current rules.

methods.name: addParamValidation
methods.description: Adds a single ParamRule validation, throws exception if a duplicate key exists.

methods.name: removeParamValidation
methods.description: Removes a validation rule by parameter key.

methods.name: isStrict
methods.description: Checks if strict validation mode is enabled.

methods.name: setStrict
methods.description: Enables or disables strict validation mode.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns the validations map as an array.

methods.name: getExcludedParamKeys
methods.description: Returns the list of parameter keys excluded from validation.

methods.name: setExcludedParamKeys
methods.description: Sets the list of excluded parameter keys.

methods.name: addExcludedParamKey
methods.description: Adds a single key to the list of excluded parameter keys.
